_about: The five principles: the single source for every slide that shows one (structure flow, framework stack and its repeat, rail, dividers, and the data-principle of each principle's slides). One principle per line. color is the theme token that fills it; builds_on is the line on its divider about the principle before it (empty for the first).

principles.name: Shared Domain
principles.statement: Agree the plan before any number.

principles.name: Consistency
principles.statement: Numbers come only from tested code.
principles.builds_on: The shared plan says which parts never change.

principles.name: Evidence
principles.statement: Every number can be followed back.
principles.builds_on: Tested code (and everything else) leaves a trail we can follow.

principles.name: Accountability
principles.statement: Ask only where a person must decide.
principles.builds_on: The evidence is what you decide with.

principles.name: Verification
principles.builds_on: Each challenge is yours to use or dismiss.
